rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=8, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0007, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-9 (one knob vs iter-7 best). NUMBERS: at the n_outer=1 operating point, RMSE is stuck ~0.00554 (iter-7 0.005542 thresh0.0007; iter-8 0.005541 motion_window3 = NO effect). soft_thresh + motion_window axes exhausted -> the ~6.3pct-above-baseline gap is NOT in the residual densification. Note n_bands was only swept at the BROKEN n_outer=0 operating point (iters 2-3); at the GOOD n_outer=1 point only n_bands=6 tested. FAILURE MODE: step-1 aliasing-free FBP structure fidelity limits how small/clean the single residual correction can be. wu_n_bands partitions the ramp into finer radial-frequency sub-bands with per-radius sigmoid weights; Wus paper uses 8. ONE KNOB: wu_n_bands 6 -> 8 (n_outer/thresh/motion locked at iter-7). HYPOTHESIS: if a finer 8-band radial partition improves step-1s structural match to the true aliasing-free image, the single residual add-back becomes a smaller and cleaner correction -> RMSE drops below the 0.005214 baseline and hr>0 clears; if the extra high-freq bands mostly add noise (RMSE up), 6 bands is confirmed optimal at this operating point. Budget: +2 bands ~ +1/3 back-projection work, still seconds.
